text:
Kaito Sato: hit an odd one during the afternoon lab: our exponential-backoff retry wrapper retries mid-stream and ends up replaying partial frames. json_mode parser then throws 'Extra data after top-level value' or occasionally returns duplicated function_call events.
Rina Patel: are you using client-side backoff with replay, or relying on the SDK retry?
Kaito Sato: it's our own helper in the sample app that adds jitter and retries on 401/network errors. it replays the same request object which in streaming land means the parser receives a second sequence of frames without being reset.
Alex Gomez: that explains duplication. Two failure modes: (1) parser buffer concat -> "extra data" errors, (2) identical function_call payload applied twice if client replayed full stream.
Rina Patel: quick mitigation for the sample: show an idempotency_key pattern and recommend short-circuiting client replay for stream endpoints. server will dedupe tokenized streams if idempotency present.
Kaito Sato: good call. also noticed that our backoff jitter increases delay > stream TTL, so sometimes reconnect frames contain HTML auth pages in certain proxies. parser sees '<' and crashes, which is confusing for new folks.
Alex Gomez: two fixes: SDK should reset parser state before attempting to re-subscribe/replay, and SDK should provide a retry-safe helper with built-in idempotency and safe parser lifecycle management. keep custom backoff outside the wrapper or expose hooks.
Rina Patel: propose new helper API: client.responses.createRetrySafe({..., retry_policy, idempotency_key?: string, parser_behavior: 'reset'|'reuse' }) which by default (a) injects idempotency_key if missing, (b) pauses/destroys parser on retry, (c) surfaces raw_frames on parse failure. That would lower onboarding fragility.
Kaito Sato: sample snippet for docs we can add:
```js
// safe retry helper for streaming json_mode
const res = await client.responses.createRetrySafe({
  model: 'redwood-chat-1',
  json_mode: true,
  function_call: { name: 'create_issue', arguments_schema: issueSchema },
  retry_policy: { max_attempts: 3, backoff_ms: 200, jitter: true }
});
```
Alex Gomez: also expose `on_parse_error: 'raw'` option so beginners can inspect the raw stream fragment instead of mysterious thrown errors. we should not silently coerce by default.
Rina Patel: parity note: JS and Py should implement the same default parser lifecycle. historically Py rebuilt the parser per connection which avoided the concat bug; JS tended to reuse an incremental parser instance which hit this. call out parity in the changelog.
Kaito Sato: for bootcamp changes: (1) replace naive retry snippet with idempotency + advice to avoid replaying streaming requests, (2) add a troubleshooting section about auth pages/proxies contaminating streams, (3) include a tiny test harness that simulates backoff+401 mid-stream so trainers can reproduce locally.
Alex Gomez: I'll file a DEVEX ticket for the helper + parser reset and add unit tests that simulate: mid-stream 401, SSE reconnect with keepalive bytes, and replayed frames.
Devex Bot: New issue created: DEVEX-1527 - "createRetrySafe helper + parser lifecycle reset on client-side retry/backoff" https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/DEVEX-1527 :white_check_mark:
Rina Patel: I'll update the bootcamp repo README and the onboarding slides to include the idempotency example and the 'inspect raw_frames' snippet.
Kaito Sato: thanks team. small change but huge DX improvement for live sessions. :tada: 
Alex Gomez: follow-up: consider adding telemetry when parser reset occurs so we can correlate onboarding crashes to retry behavior (helps us triage customer issues faster).
Rina Patel: good idea. we can emit a low-cardinality event like `parser_reset_on_retry` with model+json_mode flag. add to DEVEX-1527 if you want to take it.
Kaito Sato: leaving a note to trainers: if attendees see syntax errors during streaming labs, ask if they added client-side replay/backoff and suggest enabling the sample helper or idempotency.
Alex Gomez: will PR SDK patch by EOD tomorrow, include regression tests and changelog entry.
Devex Bot: DEVEX-1527 status updated: assignee set to Alex Gomez, priority P2.
